name: opencore-smbios-switch
description: 黑苹果（OpenCore）机型切换与三码的完整流程：判断该不该换机型、换机型与内置 USB 图的耦合冲突、board-id 变化带来的系统卷重建、CPUFriendDataProvider 必须同步重做、序列号/MLB/UUID 生成与三类判据、ROM 必须是 en0 真实 MAC、换码风控纪律，以及正确顺序与救援路径。
description_en: Full workflow for switching the SMBIOS model and regenerating board serials on a hackintosh OpenCore setup — deciding whether to switch, the coupling conflict between the SMBIOS model and Apple's built-in USB maps, the system-volume rebuild caused by a new board-id, why CPUFriendDataProvider must be rebuilt in the same change, serial/MLB/UUID generation with the three-class validity check, why ROM must be the real en0 MAC, account-flagging discipline, and the correct order with a rescue path.
